'''Laboratory slimes''' are monsters found inside the [[Dragonkin Laboratory]]. They have the ability to quickly multiply if they attack a player using [[melee]]. If they do manage to attack, a smaller and weaker dark green slime will appear saying {{RSFont|Bloop}}. These smaller slimes have less health, but use much faster melee attacks. The smaller slimes do not provide [[experience]] nor drop anything. The big ones will spawn a spawnling once every 2 auto attacks capping at a maximum of 4 spawnlings per adult.

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%.
